info.name: Flowable REST Access Tokens History PlanItem API
List of historic plan item instances

params.name: planItemInstanceId
params.description: The id of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: planItemInstanceName
params.description: The name of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: planItemInstanceState
params.description: The state of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: caseDefinitionId
params.description: The id of the definition of the case were the historic planItem instance is defined.

params.name: caseInstanceId
params.description: The id of the case instance were the historic planItem instance existed.

params.name: caseInstanceIds
params.description: The ids of the case instances were the historic planItem instance existed.

params.name: stageInstanceId
params.description: The id of the stage were the historic planItem instance was contained.

params.name: elementId
params.description: The id of the planItem model of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: planItemDefinitionId
params.description: The id of the planItem model definition of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: planItemDefinitionType
params.description: The type of planItem of the historic planItem instance.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were created before this date.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were created after this date.

params.name: lastAvailableBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in available before this date.

params.name: lastAvailableAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in available state after this date.

params.name: lastEnabledBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in enabled state before this date.

params.name: lastEnabledAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in enabled state after this date.

params.name: lastDisabledBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in disable state before this date.

params.name: lastDisabledAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in disabled state after this date.

params.name: lastStartedBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in active state before this date.

params.name: lastStartedAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in active state after this date.

params.name: lastSuspendedBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in suspended state before this date.

params.name: lastSuspendedAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were last in suspended state after this date.

params.name: completedBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were completed before this date.

params.name: completedAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were completed after this date.

params.name: terminatedBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were terminated before this date.

params.name: terminatedAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were terminated after this date.

params.name: occurredBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that occurred before this date.

params.name: occurredAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that occurred after after this date.

params.name: exitBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that exit before this date.

params.name: exitAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that exit after this date.

params.name: endedBefore
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that ended before this date.

params.name: endedAfter
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that ended after this date.

params.name: startUserId
params.description: Return only historic planItem instances that were started by this user.

params.name: referenceId
params.description: The id of process that was referenced by this historic planItem instance.

params.name: referenceType
params.description: The type of reference to the process referenced by this historic planItem instance.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: Only return instances with the given tenantId.

params.name: withoutTenantId
params.description: If true, only returns instances without a tenantId set. If false, the withoutTenantId parameter is ignored.

info.name: Query for historic plan item instances

items.docs: All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic plan item instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long.
